flagged.title: Context: Education & 1980s Britain
flagged.reason: The video defines Assessment Objective 4 (AO4) as understanding context, whereas AO4 on the Eduqas specification is accurate written English (SPaG), and context is not credited on this component.

mark_affecting.video_says: Specifically, Assessment Objective 4, or AO4. Now, AO4 requires you to demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between the text and the context in which it was written.
mark_affecting.lesson_says: Your drama question credits AO1 (response to the text), AO2 (language, form and structure) and AO4 (accurate written English). Context is not credited here, so never write a separate history paragraph.
